title: peucedanum brachystylum
intro: Peucedanum brachystylum, commonly known as Chinese Angelica, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing fever, relieving pain, and promoting digestion, as well as its use as a diuretic and anti-diabetic agent. The bioactive constituents of Peucedanum brachystylum include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
